class.name: GameplayGameMode
class.brief_description: Server-only authority for admission, player lifecycle, and match transitions.
class.description: GameplayGameMode owns authoritative gameplay decisions. It may operate offline, but in a multiplayer tree its mutating operations require this node to have multiplayer authority. Clients should consume [GameplayGameState] and must not instantiate a game mode as their rule authority.

method.name: admit_player
method.description: Admits a controller and player state, links them, and registers the state with [member game_state].

method.name: end_match
method.description: Ends the authoritative match and sets the game-state phase to [code]&"ended"[/code].

method.name: get_player_count
method.description: Returns the number of live admitted controllers.

method.name: is_authority_context
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] offline or when this node has multiplayer authority.

method.name: remove_player
method.description: Removes an admitted controller. If [param preserve_player_state] is [code]true[/code], its deactivated player state remains in [member game_state] for reconnect or travel.

method.name: start_match
method.description: Starts the authoritative match and sets the game-state phase to [code]&"in_progress"[/code].

members.member: The shared match state controlled by this game mode.

signal.name: player_removed
signal.description: Emitted after a controller is removed.
